name: Orca Engine
description: Server-side intelligence engine for the Orca X TV app: personalization, recommendations, caching, and centralized administration.
overview: The brain/backbone for the Orca X Android TV client.

versions.changelog: First alpha: personalized home (spotlight, For You, Because You Watched, mood rows), behavior capture and affinity profiles, content recommender with diversity re-rank, availability-aware Jellyseerr discovery and engine-proxied requests, cross-row de-duplication and expanded requestable rows.
